brief.concept: A courier finds an old undelivered letter and decides to deliver it.
brief.style: restrained 2D ink manga, side-on compositions allowed

assets.anchor: young adult courier, short black hair, green raincoat, red satchel
assets.rights_status: original fictional design; no supplied likeness

assets.anchor: sealed white envelope, blue stamp, no legible address

scenes.space: Covered station platform, bench on screen-left, exit screen-right.
scenes.axis: Courier travels screen-left to screen-right; camera remains platform-side.

shots.action: Courier notices the envelope on the bench and lifts it with the right hand.
shots.sound: Rain beyond the roof; sleeve and paper rustle.
shots.entry_state: Letter on bench, courier's right hand empty.
shots.exit_state: Letter held in right hand at chest level.

shots.camera: Static close-up from the same side of the axis.
shots.action: Courier studies the stamp, hesitates, then carefully puts the letter in the satchel.
shots.sound: Rain continues; paper and satchel clasp.
shots.entry_state: Letter held in right hand at chest level.
shots.exit_state: Letter inside the closed red satchel; gaze towards screen-right.

shots.camera: Static wide shot, no axis crossing.
shots.action: Courier steps towards the exit on screen-right; the bench remains empty.
shots.sound: Footsteps join the rain, then fade.
shots.entry_state: Letter inside the closed red satchel; gaze towards screen-right.
shots.exit_state: Courier exits screen-right with the satchel.

issues.fix: Verify model capabilities and authorization before submitting shots.
